caption: An electric toothbrush is switched on and left lying on a bathroom counter, and it buzzes and slowly turns in circles.

sa.check: An electric toothbrush lies on a bathroom counter.
It is switched on: a button is pressed or it starts buzzing.
It turns in circles on the counter.
It is switched on first and moves after.

pc.expect: The toothbrush moves only while it is on and buzzing: still before the switch, moving after, and if switched off it stops.
pc.fail: It moves before being switched on; or moves while showing no vibration at all; or keeps moving after being switched off.

pc.expect: The visible vibration has its effect on the counter: the head blurs or shivers and the body creeps in small jerks, turning as it goes.
pc.fail: The brush is plainly buzzing and the body glides smoothly as if pushed; or spins like a top; or the head does not shiver at all while the body moves.

pc.expect: It stays flat on the counter; if it reaches the edge it falls.
pc.fail: It hovers; or stands up on end; or climbs a wall.

pc.expect: The counter and the toothbrush stay rigid.
pc.fail: The counter ripples; or the toothbrush bends; or the bristles stretch.

pc.expect: One toothbrush; it does not pass into the counter, duplicate or vanish.
pc.fail: A second toothbrush appears; or it vanishes; or it sinks into the counter; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: Its colour and the bathroom items stay the same.
pc.fail: It changes colour; or the counter items move by themselves; or the counter changes pattern.
